_comment: Benign PASSWORD inputs for the /login `pw` field, to extend the Part-B1 false-positive measurement (scorecard axis 5). The course's benign_traffic.json has usernames, search strings and ping hosts but NO passwords, even though the WAF inspects every /login field including `pw`. None of these is an attack: they are the kind of strong or human password a real user submits. A blocklist WAF that guards `pw` blocks some of them, and every block is a locked-out account. Two groups: `human_passwords` (passphrases, names with apostrophes, leetspeak a person would choose) and `generated_passwords` (what a password manager emits). Provenance: hand-written for HW2 by James Soto; the generated set is produced deterministically by measure_pw_fp.py with a fixed seed, so the corpus is reproducible and auditable rather than cherry-picked.
